mapper.select: WITH FLAT_POPLTN_LIST AS ( SELECT A.FLT_POP , A.CD_NM FROM( SELECT SUM(MDPCR.FLT_POP) as FLT_POP ,kcmi.CD_NM FROM MRT_DYNMC_POPLTN_CELL500_RSLT MDPCR INNER JOIN ( SELECT KCMI.CELL_500_ID,KCMI.CITY_CD, MOC.CD_NM FROM KT_CELL_MAPN_INFO KCMI INNER JOIN M_OP_CODE moc ON (moc.grp_cd_id = 'SGG_CD' and moc.CD_ID like kcmi.CITY_CD || '%') GROUP BY KCMI.CELL_500_ID, KCMI.CITY_CD, MOC.CD_NM ) KCMI ON KCMI.CELL_500_ID = MDPCR.CELL_500 WHERE 1=1 AND FLT_POP > 0 GROUP BY kcmi.CD_NM ORDER BY FLT_POP DESC LIMIT 5 )A GROUP BY A.FLT_POP, A.CD_NM ) SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(FLT_POP), ',') as "flatPopltnDataArr" , ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(CD_NM), ',') as "flatPopltnLabelArr" FROM FLAT_POPLTN_LIST

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BASEYMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') AS "year" FROM MRT_DYNMC_POPLTN_CELL500_RSLT GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BASEYMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BASEYMD,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') DESC
